workflow: A caller supplies an object that provides some expected interface behavior but is not the concrete record type assumed by native code.
The implementation skips validating the object’s concrete representation and accesses fields at fixed offsets for that record type.
Those offsets refer to unrelated or out-of-bounds memory in the supplied object.
The resulting arbitrary value causes incorrect results or an invalid memory access that can terminate the process.],
